column2: The rock diamonds come up in, carried from deep in the mantle in narrow volcanic pipes. It's named after Kimberley in South Africa, home of the hand-dug Big Hole.
"Petrified lightning": glass tubes formed where lightning melts sand or rock. They turn up so often in viral photos that it's far from an obscure answer.
